problem: API inside Docker read immutable snapshot Parquet over the Windows/WSL2 bind mount on every request; the overview also copied ~1M rows into a temp table per request.
changes: checksum-verified container-local cache of the immutable snapshot, keyed by snapshot id (api.local_snapshot)
explicit 256MB DuckDB memory cap per request
unfiltered overview uses a view instead of materialising ~1M rows; filtered requests keep the parameterised temp table
rejected_change: Narrow-key lineage rewrite: identical results but slower on the host (0.47 s vs 0.29 s), so it was reverted.
note: Single-machine curl samples; the repeated-measurement benchmark is evidence/benchmark-queries.json (taken after this change). A regression (prepared parameters in a view) was caught by this equivalence check before acceptance.
